ctx.x: Well, at the 845, I'm thinking... Bishop was still with the band at the 845, I think. I'm quite sure he was. But I think he stayed with the band until he went to Europe.

Then they brought in a fellow named Nelson, Kirby's man. Oh, Nelson. I forgot all about Nelson. He was in Kirby's band; he was a trumpet player.
